events.title: The Nutcracker
events.blurb: Ballet Theatre of Scranton's free holiday Nutcracker, with two shows a day all weekend. Seating is reserved; pick up tickets at the box office starting two hours before each show.
events.blurbEs: El Nutcracker navideño y gratis de Ballet Theatre of Scranton, con dos funciones al día todo el fin de semana. Los asientos son reservados; recoge tus boletos en taquilla desde dos horas antes de cada función.

events.title: Holiday Window Showcase
events.blurb: Scranton Tomorrow's decorated storefront windows around downtown, on display through New Year's Day.
events.blurbEs: Escaparates decorados por Scranton Tomorrow en el centro, en exhibición hasta el Año Nuevo.

events.title: Small Business Saturday downtown
events.blurb: Downtown shops run Black Friday and Small Business Saturday specials. Scranton Tomorrow has the list of participating businesses.
events.blurbEs: Las tiendas del centro tienen ofertas de Black Friday y Small Business Saturday. Scranton Tomorrow tiene la lista de negocios participantes.

events.title: Holiday Light Spectacular at Nay Aug Park
events.addr: Arthur Ave & Mulberry St, Scranton, PA 18510
events.blurb: A drive-through holiday light display in Nay Aug Park, open nightly from Nov. 25. Hours are expected to be about 5 to 9 p.m. but aren't confirmed yet; enter via Arthur Avenue at Mulberry Street.
events.blurbEs: Un recorrido en auto entre luces navideñas en Nay Aug Park, abierto todas las noches desde el 25 de noviembre. Se espera que el horario sea de 5 a 9 p.m., pero aún no está confirmado; entra por Arthur Avenue en Mulberry Street.
events.getThere: Approach via Arthur Avenue to the Mulberry Street entrance near the Everhart Museum; avoid Mulberry Street near Geisinger Community Medical Center.

events.title: Wilkes-Barre/Scranton Penguins home games
events.blurb: Two AHL home games: the Penguins face the Providence Bruins Friday night and the Lehigh Valley Phantoms Sunday afternoon.
events.blurbEs: Dos partidos de la AHL en casa: los Penguins enfrentan a los Providence Bruins el viernes por la noche y a los Lehigh Valley Phantoms el domingo por la tarde.

events.title: Santa on the Trolley
events.blurb: A 45-minute round-trip trolley ride with Santa, with five departures each Saturday and Sunday. Reservations are by phone only, at (570) 963-6590.
events.blurbEs: Un paseo en tranvía de 45 minutos, ida y vuelta, con Santa, con cinco salidas cada sábado y domingo. Las reservaciones son solo por teléfono, al (570) 963-6590.
events.getThere: On the Steamtown National Historic Site grounds; park entrance at Cliff Street and Lackawanna Avenue.

events.title: 14th Annual Buy Local Holiday Marketplace
events.venue: Scranton Cultural Center at the Masonic Temple
events.blurb: More than 95 local makers and vendors across five floors of the Cultural Center. The first 1,000 shoppers get a free tote bag.
events.blurbEs: Más de 95 artesanos y vendedores locales en cinco pisos del Cultural Center. Los primeros 1,000 compradores reciben una bolsa gratis.

events.title: James Barrett Album Release Show
events.venue: F.M. Kirby Center for the Performing Arts
events.blurb: The Scranton indie-punk songwriter celebrates his new album with guests University Drive and Purple Lung. It's general admission and standing room only; doors open at 6 p.m.
events.blurbEs: El cantautor indie-punk de Scranton celebra su nuevo álbum con los invitados University Drive y Purple Lung. La entrada es general y de pie; las puertas abren a las 6 p.m.

events.title: Elvis Tribute Artist Spectacular Holiday Show Starring Shawn Klush
events.blurb: A holiday Elvis tribute in the Keystone Grand Ballroom; doors open at 6 p.m. It's open to all ages, but guests under 21 must come with an adult and use the hotel entrance.
events.blurbEs: Un tributo navideño a Elvis en el Keystone Grand Ballroom; las puertas abren a las 6 p.m. Está abierto a todas las edades, pero los menores de 21 deben ir con un adulto y entrar por la entrada del hotel.

events.title: Anthony Devito with Tito Garza and Shevaun Brannigan
events.venue: Wise Crackers Comedy Club, Mohegan Pennsylvania
events.blurb: Stand-up from Anthony Devito, with a late show each night; doors open an hour before showtime, and the lineup may change.
events.blurbEs: Stand-up de Anthony Devito, con una función tarde cada noche; las puertas abren una hora antes y el elenco puede cambiar.
